title: Move money / station placement
slide_intent: Make an offer readable in passing because transport environments give viewers limited attention.
strategic_value: The green card and repeated action words can make Wise visible despite movement in front of the poster.
demonstration: A station poster places a large green card on the left and a stack of short money phrases on the right; a passing train blurs the lower foreground.
practical_value: Check whether a product silhouette and short word stack survive partial obstruction.

content_islands.name: Product half
content_islands.spec: Use the left field for the card and textured color.

content_islands.name: Copy half
content_islands.spec: Stack the action-led phrases on the right.

content_islands.spec: Keep the station roundel and foreground motion blur.
